h1: When is a Certificate of Occupancy or Completion required in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Certificate of Occupancy and Completion: Final Sign-Offs
description: Learn why a project may need final inspections and closure of related permits before the City completes its approval process.
short_answer: Newton requires final inspections for permits and tells property owners to close electrical, plumbing, gas, and other department permits before requesting final inspection on a building permit. Whether a project needs a Certificate of Occupancy, Certificate of Completion, or another final sign-off depends on the project and approval conditions. Confirm the required certificate with ISD.

facts.text: Newton states that a final inspection is required for all permits.
Newton instructs property owners to close electrical, plumbing, gas, and other department permits before calling for a final inspection on the building permit.

qa.q: Can I consider a project complete when the contractor says the work is finished?
qa.a: Not necessarily. Newton advises property owners to verify that required permits are closed and final inspections are complete before treating the project as closed out.
